regime_context: Broad theme eligibility (12 of 16 eligible) with no single dominant narrative. Big Banks lead on momentum and breadth but are crowded; rotation is non-directional and no handoff is confirmed. The absolute trend gate is the only validated edge (drawdown control, gate_helps=true). Macro backdrop dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics narratives with elevated unscheduled surprise share. The discipline is trend-following risk management, not return forecasting.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The theme remains eligible (absolute trend gate passed), with high durability (0.7) and full constituent breadth (1.0), suggesting trend integrity. The gate's validated risk control supports staying with the trend, but the momentum rank is not a return predictor and crowding (z=1.23) demands sizing caution. This is a continuation lean, not a momentum buy.
evidence: gate_helps=true validates risk-reducing properties of trend discipline
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has no predictive power and the theme is crowded; trend may stall or reverse without warning, leading to a drawdown despite the gate's historical risk control.

falsifier.text: Big Banks becomes ineligible (score turns negative and absolute trend breaks) or breadth collapses below 0.5.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are ineligible (trend gate failed), with low durability (0.31) and a likely downtrend (hurst_tag=trend). The absolute trend gate is the only validated edge, and avoiding such themes has historically reduced drawdowns and volatility. The shared proxy XGD.TO also captures Silver & Royalties (also ineligible), reinforcing avoidance of the precious metals complex.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend (likely a sustained directional move, unfavorable)
backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate validated as risk control
theses.dissent: Gold miners may mean-revert sharply from oversold levels; the trend gate can occasionally flip quickly, and missing a brief rally could create opportunity cost.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners becomes eligible (absolute trend re-establishes, score turns positive) and durability_bar rises above 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
